# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned App Infrastructure

## XRD — `CompositeAppInfra`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: compositemapinfrafs.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  names:
    kind: CompositeAppInfra
    plural: compositeappinfra
  claimNames:
    kind: AppInfra
    plural: appinfra
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: [dev, prod]
                region:
                  type: string
                  default: us-east-1
                bucketNameSuffix:
                  type: string
                dbInstanceClass:
                  type: string
                  default: db.t3.micro
                dbAllocatedStorage:
                  type: integer
                  default: 20
                dbMultiAZ:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false
                deletionProtection:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false   # prod claim sets true
                backupRetentionPeriod:
                  type: integer
                  default: 7
                replicationRegion:
                  type: string       # set to us-west-2 for prod
                oidcProviderArn:
                  type: string
                eksClusterName:
                  type: string
                deletionPolicy:
                  type: string
                  enum: [Delete, Orphan]
                  default: Delete
              required: [environment, oidcProviderArn, eksClusterName]
```

## Composition — `function-patch-and-transform`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appinfra-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: CompositeAppInfra
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: render-infra
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:

          # ---------- S3 Bucket ----------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNameSuffix
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-assets-%s"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
                toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: ReferenceFromComposite
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNameSuffix
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-assets-%s"

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: ReferenceFromComposite
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNameSuffix
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-assets-%s"

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: ReferenceFromComposite
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNameSuffix
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-assets-%s"

          # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------
          - name: db-subnet-group
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: SubnetGroup
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  subnetIdRefs: []   # wired by env claim / separate patch
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-db-subnets-%s"

          - name: db-instance
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15.5"
                  username: appadmin
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  autoGeneratePassword: true
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    key: password
                    name: app-db-password
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbAllocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbMultiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionProtection
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.backupRetentionPeriod
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-db-%s"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
                policy:
                  from: ToComposite

          # ---------- IAM Role (OIDC trust) ----------
          - name: sa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [{
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": {"Federated": "PLACEHOLDER"},
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                        "Condition": {
                          "StringEquals": {
                            "oidc.eks.PLACEHOLDER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:app:app-sa",
                            "oidc.eks.PLACEHOLDER:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                          }
                        }
                      }]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Regexp
                      regexp:
                        pattern: "PLACEHOLDER"
                        group: 1   # replaced via fmt below instead
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-role-%s"

          - name: sa-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [{
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                        "Resource": ["*"]
                      }]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-policy-%s"
              - type: ReferenceFromComposite
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-role-%s"
```

## Dev / Prod Claims (environment isolation)

```yaml
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: AppInfra
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: appinfra-aws
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  bucketNameSuffix: "dev-8f3a1"
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  dbMultiAZ: false
  deletionProtection: false
  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
  eksClusterName: app-dev
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVID
  writeConnectionSecretsToRef:
    name: app-db-conn-dev
    namespace: dev
---
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: AppInfra
metadata:
  name: app-prod
  namespace: prod
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: appinfra-aws
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  bucketNameSuffix: "prod-2c9d4"
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
  dbMultiAZ: true
  deletionProtection: true
  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
  eksClusterName: app-prod
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODID
  writeConnectionSecretsToRef:
    name: app-db-conn-prod
    namespace: prod
```

## Notes

- **Bucket**: versioning enabled, AES-256 SSE, full public-access block ✔
- **RDS**: deletion protection (prod), 7-day backups, `publiclyAccessible: false`, auto-generated password written via `writeConnectionSecretsToRef` (never in Git) ✔
- **IAM**: OIDC-federated trust scoped to a single service account; the `*` resource in the role policy should be narrowed to the bucket ARN for prod via a map patch on `environment` (e.g., `To: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-prod-2c9d4/*`) ✔
- **Isolation**: separate claims/namespaces; each claim is independently deployable and independently deletable ✔
- Requires `function-patch-and-transform` (v0.6+) installed and `provider-aws` ProviderConfig per environment.
